page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6r.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs based on the 64-bit ARM architecture, specifically utilizing the Ampere Altra processor running at a baseline clock speed of 2.8 GHz. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying on network-attached storage options, and delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks position this instance primarily in the average tier for multi-core and memory operations, with some single-core limitations. The stress-ng multi-core CPU test yielded 14,296.73, and the Geekbench multi-core score reached 6,111.0, both falling within the average range. However, single-core performance is weaker, as evidenced by a Geekbench single-core score of 1,095.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 6,192.59. Memory bandwidth is robust, with read-only small block cached speeds at 568.34 GB/sec and large block uncached write speeds at 47.27 GB/sec. Cryptographic performance is supported by hardware AES, though overall encryption benchmarks remain in the lower tier.

Given its hardware profile, the ecs.g6r.2xlarge offers a cost-efficient option for ARM-native workloads that benefit from dedicated physical cores without requiring high-frequency single-thread performance. It is well-suited for multi-threaded applications such as static web serving, where it achieved a throughput of 10.65 GB/sec, and database operations, supported by a Redis SET performance of 10.86 million operations per second. Other suitable workloads include software compilation and text processing. It is less suitable for intensive single-threaded tasks, heavy cryptographic operations, or large-scale machine learning inference.
